about_the_game:
Moon Stop is a narrative-driven puzzle walk simulator set in the haunting stillness of a lunar base.

In an isolated and desolate environment, you play as a solitary astronaut searching for the last memory of her daughter. Through exploration of silent corridors and the solving of atmospheric puzzles, you will piece together fragments of the past and uncover a deeply emotional story about love, loss, and the universal need for connection.

Key Features:

  • 🌙 Atmospheric Exploration – Wander through a cold, abandoned lunar base brought to life with immersive soundscapes and environmental storytelling.

  • 🧩 Puzzle Solving – Engage with thoughtful puzzles to make your way through the space station.

  • ❤️ Emotional Narrative – Experience a poignant tale about the bonds between mother and child, told through memories, discovery, and quiet reflection.

  • 🎧 Immersive Ambience – Minimalist design and sound immerse you in a lonely yet moving journey through silence and space.

Step into the emptiness of the Moon. Discover what remains when everything else is gone.
